name: App icon

# The iOS app and the desktop app share one Icon Composer bundle
# (apps/mobile/assets/icon.icon, copied to apps/desktop/build/icon.icon).
# EAS compiles the iOS copy with Xcode's actool; electron-builder compiles the
# desktop copy. This job compiles both the same way on a pull request, so a
# broken bundle fails here, and renders each appearance with Icon Composer's
# ictool for review (artifact `app-icon-previews`). macos-26: on macos-15,
# Xcode 26.3's asset agent crashes when it renders a glass layer for macOS.
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'apps/mobile/assets/icon.icon/**'
      - 'apps/desktop/build/icon.icon/**'
      - '.github/workflows/app-icon.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

name: Desktop release

# Publishes signed, notarized Apple Silicon installers for each main push that
# changes the app or something it bundles (the daemon client, protocol, lockfile).
# Versions use a fixed epoch above earlier calendar versions and the workflow
# run number: 2026.10000.<run_number>. Retries keep the version and built commit.
# Manual builds that skip notarization remain drafts.
#
# Existing signing and notarization credentials come from Infisical prod:/platform.
# ASC_* names are mapped to the release tools' APPLE_* inputs inside the runner.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'apps/desktop/**'
      # Shared renderer source and build inputs are part of the shipped app.
      - 'apps/frontend/**'
      - 'app/\[locale\]/**'
      - 'app/actions/**'
      - 'app/fonts/**'
      - 'app/globals.css'
      - 'components/**'
      - 'hooks/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'messages/**'

      - 'packages/config/**'

      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'packages/daemon/**'
      - 'packages/protocol/**'
      - 'lib/daemon-commands.ts'
      - 'lib/local-device-setup.ts'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'patches/**'
      - 'scripts/release/**'
      - 'config/release-security.json'
      - '.github/workflows/desktop-release.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      overlay-sha:
        description: Private main revision expected from the dispatching push
        type: string
        default: ''
      skip_notarization:
        description: Build macOS without notarization (internal testing only)
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read

env:

name: CI

# Merge-blocking source and database checks run on GitHub's PR merge candidate,
# not a same-repository branch push. This avoids duplicating the same expensive
# jobs and detects integration failures against the target branch at PR time.
# - pull_request: premerge checks (same-repo and fork PRs);
# - merge_group: synthetic queue candidate, if a queue is enabled later;
# - push main: postmerge verification of each distinct main commit.
# CI runs no browser tests (decision 2026-11-01-1520). Preserve the existing
# protected status-check names.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 3 * * 1'

permissions:

concurrency:
